author: mvtk1978
description: Boxerbook remote MCP server: professional boxing schedule, results, boxer cards, WBC/WBA/IBF/WBO/The Ring/TBRB rankings, forecasts and where to watch. Free, no key. https://mcp.boxerbook.com/mcp
name: Boxerbook

prompts.name: fight_night_guide
prompts.title: Fight night guide
prompts.description: What boxing is on today (or on a date), where to watch it and at what time.

arguments.name: date
arguments.description: a date (YYYY-MM-DD) or words like "tonight", "Saturday"; default tonight

arguments.name: country
arguments.description: two-letter country of the cards, e.g. GB, US (optional)

prompts.name: boxer_briefing
prompts.title: Boxer briefing
prompts.description: A boxer's card, last bouts, next fight, rating and forecast.

prompts.name: weekend_results
prompts.title: Weekend results
prompts.description: The results of the weekend's cards, title fights and upsets first.

arguments.name: country
arguments.description: two-letter country of the cards, e.g. GB, US (optional)

resources.name: schedule-today
resources.title: Boxing schedule today
resources.description: Today's cards (and last night's still running) with start times in UTC, broadcasters, forecast and market consensus: the boxing_schedule answer for when=today.

resources.name: results-last-night
resources.title: Boxing results of last night
resources.description: Completed bouts of last night and today with sources: the boxing_results answer for days=2.

resources.name: status
resources.title: Boxerbook data status
resources.description: Data freshness: last rating run, number of bouts and boxers, version.

resources.name: about
resources.title: About the Boxerbook data
resources.description: What the database covers, where the records come from, and which tool answers which question.

tools.name: boxing_schedule
tools.title: Boxing schedule
tools.description: Upcoming professional boxing cards worldwide, grouped by card: date, start_utc (card start in UTC), venue, promoter, broadcasters, and each bout with both records going in, division, scheduled rounds, title, Boxerbook forecast and market consensus when known. Use this for "who is fighting tonight / this weekend", "what boxing is on". when=today also keeps last night's cards that started under 6 hours ago. Cite the url of each card or bout.

when.description: today (and cards still running from last night), tonight, weekend (Fri-Sun) or 30d

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the bout, e.g. GB, US, MX

division.description: division code (hea, wel, w_fea) or name (heavyweight, women's featherweight)

truncated.description: true when the 400-bout cap of the underlying list may have dropped bouts of this window (narrow it with country or division)

start_utc.description: ISO UTC start of the card, when known

p_a.description: Boxerbook model probability that side a wins
no-vig consensus probability of side a

opening.description: the opening line (first live snapshot); /v1/bouts/{id} only

partial.description: true when part of the data could not be read this time; retry in a minute for the full answer

tools.name: boxing_results
tools.title: Boxing results
tools.description: Completed professional bouts of the last N days (N calendar days ending today: 1 = today, 2 = last night and today, up to 14), newest first: winner, method, round, time, both records going in and the sources of each result. Use this for "who won last night", "results this weekend". Cite the url of each bout.

days.description: number of days ending today (default 2: last night and today)

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the bout, e.g. GB, US, MX

division.description: division code (hea, wel, w_fea) or name (heavyweight, women's featherweight)

truncated.description: true when the 400-bout cap of the underlying list may have dropped bouts of this window (narrow it with days, country or division)

partial.description: true when part of the data could not be read this time; retry in a minute for the full answer

tools.name: boxer
tools.title: Boxer card
tools.description: One boxer's card by name, slug or Boxerbook id: country, division, record (W-L-D, KOs), stance, height, reach, birth date, nickname, next fight, last result, Boxerbook rating and, when known, the record as betting favourite and underdog. A name goes through the site search and returns the best match (other_matches lists the next ones: check them when the name is common). Cite the url.

query.description: a boxer's name, slug (giorgio-visioli) or Boxerbook id

bouts_without_result.description: completed bouts whose result is not known yet (record_source bouts only); record is null when no result is known at all

partial.description: true when part of the data could not be read this time; retry in a minute for the full answer

tools.name: next_fight
tools.title: Next fight of a boxer
tools.description: A boxer's next scheduled bout (by name, slug or id): date, start_utc (card start in UTC), opponent, venue, broadcasters, Boxerbook forecast and market consensus when known; next_fight is null when none is on record (last_result is then the latest bout). Cite the url.

query.description: a boxer's name, slug (giorgio-visioli) or Boxerbook id

start_utc.description: ISO UTC start of the card, when known

p_a.description: Boxerbook model probability that side a wins
no-vig consensus probability of side a

opening.description: the opening line (first live snapshot); /v1/bouts/{id} only

as_of.description: ISO UTC time of this answer

partial.description: true when part of the data could not be read this time; retry in a minute for the full answer

tools.name: bout
tools.title: Bout
tools.description: One bout in full by Boxerbook bout id: both boxers with records going in, status, result (winner, method, round, time), start_utc, venue, card, broadcasters, sources, Boxerbook forecast with its signals and the market consensus when known. Cite the url.

id.description: Boxerbook bout id (from a schedule, results, search or a /bouts/<id> url)

missed.description: true: missed weight (a press report); null: unknown
true: missed weight (a press report); null: unknown

weighin.description: the official weigh-in, per side when known: a commission sheet before the press

p_a.description: Boxerbook model probability that side a wins
no-vig consensus probability of side a

opening.description: the opening line (first live snapshot); /v1/bouts/{id} only

signals.description: signals of the latest forecast: a and b per side (age, age_precision, record, layoff_days, last5, ko_rate, home, travel_km, mu_delta_12m, div_shift, listed_first, short_notice_days, weight_lb, missed_weight, amateur, height_cm, reach_cm, stance, ...) and bout (title, rounds, main, division, lead_days, replaced, weigh_diff_lb)

fact.description: one sentence, read by a model from the video captions

quote.description: the words as spoken (auto captions), 40 words at most

video_url.description: the YouTube video at the moment of the quote

fight_week.description: facts said in fight-week videos (press conference, weigh-in, face-off, open workout): only accepted ones, at most 24; no predictions or opinions

partial.description: true when part of the data could not be read this time; retry in a minute for the full answer

tools.name: where_to_watch
tools.title: Where to watch
tools.description: The broadcasters (platform, region, link) of a bout or of a whole card, with the card start time in UTC. Give bout_id or event_id. An empty list means none is on record yet. Cite the url.

start_utc.description: ISO UTC start of the card, when known

as_of.description: ISO UTC time of this answer

partial.description: true when part of the data could not be read this time; retry in a minute for the full answer

tools.name: rankings
tools.title: Division rankings
tools.description: The top 15 of a division: the Boxerbook rating (default) or the latest list of a publisher (WBC, WBA, IBF, WBO, The Ring, TBRB), with records. Division by code (hea, wel, w_fea) or name (heavyweight, women's flyweight). Cite the url.

division.description: division code (hea, wel, w_fea) or name (heavyweight, women's featherweight)

publisher.description: boxerbook (the Boxerbook rating), wbc, wba, ibf, wbo, ring or tbrb

partial.description: true when part of the data could not be read this time; retry in a minute for the full answer

tools.name: search_boxers
tools.title: Search boxers
tools.description: Find boxers by name (at most 20), best match first: id, slug, name, country, division, record. Use this when a name is ambiguous or its spelling unsure, then call boxer or next_fight with the id. Cite the url.

q.description: a name or part of it

partial.description: true when part of the data could not be read this time; retry in a minute for the full answer

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search Boxerbook
tools.description: Search the whole catalog with one query: boxers by name, bouts by two surnames ("Inoue vs Nakatani"), their cards, and divisions ("heavyweight rankings"); an id such as bout:123 is looked up directly. Each hit has an id for fetch, a title and its boxerbook.com url; ChatGPT connectors and deep research, which call nothing but search and fetch, start here. No match returns an empty list. Cite the url.

query.description: what to look for: a boxer, two boxers, a division

id.description: pass to fetch: boxer:<id>, bout:<id>, event:<id> or rankings:<DIV>

as_of.description: ISO UTC time of this answer

partial.description: true when part of the data could not be read this time; retry in a minute for the full answer

tools.name: fetch
tools.title: Fetch a Boxerbook document
tools.description: The full document for an id returned by search: a boxer card, a bout (records, result, broadcasters, forecast, market, sources), a card with its bouts, or a division's rankings, as Markdown text with metadata. Pass the id unchanged; an unknown id returns an error. Cite the url.

id.description: an id from search: boxer:<id>, bout:<id>, event:<id> or rankings:<DIV>

as_of.description: ISO UTC time of this answer
